symptom: ako/mxcli#1106: under `mdl 1;` a re-run `create or modify microflow` whose only change is one expression in a `set` inside a `loop` body is refused: "the Loop at (x, y) changes inside its body; the splice does not edit inside a loop, and replacing the whole loop would rebuild every node it holds. Nothing was written. [MDL-V1-REBUILD]" — so one script cannot both provision and update a flow that loops; the advised `alter … replace loop` means stating the body twice or giving up provisioning
cause: patchDiff.gap refused as soon as sameLoopShell held and the bodies differed (loopBodyChanged), without asking how they differed; alter's applyTo refused any in-loop target (enclosingLoop); the mutator's graph.node refused any node with n.loop set. The stated reason (body coordinates are relative to the loop box) only applies to changes that add, remove or move a node
file: mdl/executor/cmd_flow_modify.go (loopBody, inLoopBody, editableLoopBody, storedLocator.within, lcsStatements), mdl/executor/cmd_alter_flow.go (applyTo in-loop guard, upstreamOf/iteratorsAround/loopsAround), mdl/backend/mfmutator/splice.go (replaceInLoop)
fix: A loop body of the same shape — same length, each statement as stored, a nested loop of the same shape, or the same kind of plain activity (no if/return/break/continue, no custom error handler) whose annotations state nothing the stored one lacks — is diffed into in-place replaces, located among the loop's own objects (body @positions are loop-relative, so the top-level locator cannot be used). The mutator swaps the activity's document in the loop collection's slot, at the stored RelativeMiddlePoint and Size, and repoints the flows in/out (the last body activity has no flow out — removable() rejected it). alter accepts the same one-for-one replace; scope inside a body adds the enclosing loops' iterators and what runs before each loop. Such loops are also paired by lcsStatements so a change beside the loop does not merge with it into a replace
test: mdl/executor/cmd_flow_loop_body_edit_pedapp_test.go TestCreateOrModify_EditInsideLoopBody (only the edited activity's $ID changes, replacement at the same position, re-run Unchanged, iterator-reading edit, change beside the loop + inside it, controls insert/drop/swap/kind-change still refused with nothing written), TestCreateOrModify_EditInsideNestedLoopBody; mfmutator splice_test.go TestSplice_ReplaceInsideALoopIsInPlace (byte-exact expected unit, first and last body activity, resized stored Size kept, two-for-one refused). Fix reverted: both executor tests fail with 'changes inside its body; the splice does not edit inside a loop', the mutator test with 'alter does not splice inside a loop yet'. Real 11.14.0 app (mxcli new): old binary refuses with MDL-V1-REBUILD under mdl 1 and 'Replaced' (rebuild) under mdl 0; fixed binary 'Modified … (spliced: 1 replaced)', re-run in sync; mx check 0 errors on both copies
insight: A refusal justified by geometry (loop-relative coordinates) should be asked of the changes that actually have geometry: an in-place replace of one activity by one of the same kind moves nothing, so recurse into the body when it has the same shape and keep refusing only shape changes. Two traps on the way: describe's body @positions are relative to the loop box, so locating a body statement must use a locator over that loop's objects only; and the last activity of a loop body has no outgoing flow, so the top-level 'exactly one flow out' removability check does not apply there. When validating with the CLI binary, rebuild it after the fix — a bin/mxcli built before the change reproduced the refusal and looked like the fix failing on a real app
